name: Launch A — Reminder: 15 Minutes Before

source.primary: Final pre-live touch between the 1h reminder and the 'We're LIVE' send.
supporting: Soap Opera Email #5 — urgency and CTA at the last useful moment.
Funnel Hacker's Cookbook — the final minutes are where ad-hoc intentions become attendance.

purpose: One job: catch the registrant in the last quarter hour. SMS only, one line and the link. No email — the inbox is the wrong place fifteen minutes out.

trigger.late_registrant_rule: Registered inside the final 15 minutes: skip this file; the live reminder is the next and only appropriate touch.

sms.send: 15 minutes before, with SMS consent only
sms.body_framework: "We start in 15 minutes — [join URL]" plus the name of the host or event if it fits. One line.

copy_rules: One line. Under 160 characters where possible.
No email fallback, no pitch, no price, no countdown.
Never send to a contact without SMS consent; there is no substitute channel here.
guards: No SMS consent or DND -> no send at all. Do not substitute email.
Do not repeat the 1-hour message; this must name the 15-minute gap.

ghl_build.structure: Trigger: Tag Added `webinar-registered` -> Wait until `webinar_datetime` - 15 minutes -> If not purchased, future, and SMS consent -> Send SMS -> End.
ghl_build.notes: Pure SMS lane. Adding an email here dilutes the moment and increases unsubscribe risk.

scope.includes: Registered, not purchased, SMS-consented, 15 minutes out.
